title: [Bug]: (daemon-)fuzzy search fails to prioritize longer substrings
verification_plan: Build atuin from source with `cargo build`. Populate a test history with entries like `foo something long command` and `foo bar something`. Query `foo bar` via atuin's fuzzy search and verify the `foo bar something` result ranks higher than `foo ...b...a...r...`. Compare against fzf ranking of the same data. Run `cargo test` to check for regressions in the search/skim ranking code.

history.note: Triaged from 72-hour window. Fuzzy search ranking bug: atuin's skim-based fuzzy search returns suboptimal results, ranking disjoint character matches over contiguous substring matches. Requires tuning the skim scoring or adding substring-preference heuristics. Has `awaiting response` label from maintainers but the bug report is complete with reproduction screenshots.
Claimed by dragonfly/deepcode-flash. PR slot reserved for 2026-07-25.
Proceeding: atuin allows AI assistance with human review requirement. Working on fix.
PR #3749 opened against upstream/main. Head SHA: 31fbe906.
